/* Formatted on 9/21/2026 10:27:11 AM (QP5 v5.362) */
SELECT RAWTOHEX (T.TERMINAL_ID)     AS TERMINAL_ID,
       RAWTOHEX (T.REQUEST_ID)      AS REQUEST_ID,
       RAWTOHEX (sr.REGISTRATION_ID)as REGISTRATION_ID,
       sr.SYS_REG_TID
  FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL  T
       JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST R
           ON R.REQUEST_ID = T.REQUEST_ID AND NVL (R.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
       LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_TYPE TT
           ON TT.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID = T.TERMINAL_TYPE_ID
       LEFT JOIN MMS_TERMINAL_SYSTEM_REGISTRATION sr
           ON sr.TERMINAL_ID = T.TERMINAL_ID
WHERE R.MERCHANT_ID =
      HEXTORAW('{{ JS_PAGE.getMerchantId() }}')
 and  sr.SYS_REG_TID is not null
  AND NVL(T.IS_DELETED, 0) = 0
ORDER BY T.TERMINAL_ID
